answer: A bridge between agent wallets and verifiable work can price Sybil attacks out: every new identity must post a small bond that stays locked until it completes attested jobs, like crossing a dune field where each step costs energy. Honest agents earn the bond back with interest, while a flood of fakes burns capital on thousands of bonds that never repay. The ember of reputation - a score built only from completed, attested work - then gates high-value tasks, so a fresh fake has no history to spend and no cheap way to buy one.
